segments.en: It really is a way to cater to tourists who just want everything taken care of they want all inclusive They don't want to have to decide what time they're going for dinner and where they're going for dinner

segments.en: And so that's something that's in common even though these are very different vacation experiences Right and probably it's pretty great for Royal Caribbean to be like here on our cruise and then we're gonna take you to an island

segments.en: And then you can spend money and also that money is coming to us versus like somebody else too So you could see the logic for the business model What's the where's the pushback coming from so analysts are scratching their heads a little bit not just because Royal Caribbean hasn't done
segments.zh: 然后你在那里花钱，钱也流向我们，而不是别人。所以能看出商业模式的逻辑。那反对声音从哪来？分析师们有点摸不着头脑，不仅因为皇家加勒比以前没做过这么大的并购。
